verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a WebRTC SFU/TURN product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the user's own signaling backend can run on their infrastructure, which is an adjacent capability. The SFU and TURN themselves run on Cloudflare's managed Anycast network, and the docs stress that you do not deploy TURN servers yourself. No evidence shows the core product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
